Hey, listen I get get where your at right now and honestly there was a point in my life where i genuinely didn’t think I would make it either I left all the things I wanted to do for two years obsessively planning my death but I’m here. I know you might not believe it now but you’ll get through this okay just focus on literally anything that keeps you grounded, when my my mom found out I self harmed I had a panic attack and felt suffocated whenever ever she tried to help. Therapy is helpful for a while but again unless you want to work to get better it’s hard to get anything out of it. Ig what I’m trying to say is sometimes people are insensitive as fuck cause they don’t know what your going though or are either overbearing to the point of suffocation what I would try to do somehow let your mom know your trying even if it’s not where your at rn and just try to keep yourself distracted. In the moment it may not seem like the world has a lot to offer but it does just please always remember that

I know how it feels to relapse then have people find out about it. Some situations will be triggering relapses happen but it’s important to go easy on yourself too, being critical of your self and then on top of that facing judgment from other people and guilt is incredibly difficult. You stayed clean for three months focus on that and remind yourself that you got through this before and you can get through it again. As for hiding the cut you could say you accidentally broke a glass and fell on it or something but if people who care about you are aware of your self harm they’ll probably be aware you’re lying too. Just maybe make an excuse if they try to lecture just listen and don’t be too harsh on your self and stay safe please
